title: Audio recording/film studio with office space
description:
This place is a great location to audio engineer a band or film a music video. We have tons of props you can rent. We have various lighting kits and smoke machines and many other extras depending on what you need.

The space
You get access to the studio for a full day. We can add on any extras you might need like audio or video gear, an engineer or videographer, etc. just reach out about what your needs may be.

Guest access
You will have access to everything in the whole studio except one tiny storage closest where we keep the hard drives
